strategy.name: ackman-concentrated-catalyst
strategy.description: Concentrated long-only hedge fund style: high conviction, fundamental thesis, catalyst-driven. Objective is to MAKE MONEY — active PM, not passive hold.

positionCapacity.note: No fixed max position count. New entry allowed when buying_power >= minOrderUsd, cash >= minCashReservePct, invested <= maxPortfolioInvestedPct, conviction >= Media, and thesis doc exists. Prefer Ackman concentration; add names only if each gets meaningful size (>= minOrderUsd).

strategy.style: Bill Ackman — concentrated, activist mindset, quality + mispricing

riskControls.stopLossNote: Hard stop backup solo si tesis intacta; exit primario = tesis rota (Ackman)

exitPolicy.note: Ackman NO vende por % fijo. Sale cuando: (1) tesis rota, (2) tesis realizada / fair value, (3) mejor idea en otro lado. Trims parciales opcionales — nunca automáticos por +25%.
exitPolicy.defaultTrimNote: Si trim: tamaño definido en thesis (ej. 30–50% al fair value), no regla mecánica global

cashDeploymentPlan.description: Reglas para desplegar el cash residual ($25 actual). ADD solo post-catalizador confirmado — no mecánico pre-earnings.

AMZN_post_Q2_beat.condition: AWS revenue growth >= 25% in Q2 earnings AND thesis kill criteria not triggered
AMZN_post_Q2_beat.action: ADD up to $25 notional (full cash deploy) if post-trade cash >= 10%

MSFT_post_Q4_beat.condition: Azure guide >= 39% CC in Q4 FY26 AND thesis intact
MSFT_post_Q4_beat.action: ADD up to $15-25 notional if cash allows and AMZN already sized OR rotate from weaker name per earnings-playbook

post_earnings_new_entry.condition: Bench memo #1 (logs/theses/bench/) passes conviction >= Media + thesis memo written
post_earnings_new_entry.action: NEW entry min $15, max per positionSizing.maxOrderUsd

default.condition: No catalyst confirmation or mixed earnings
